submission.justification: Algorithm-L1 (iterative topological clustering with learned calibration) at 34 GeV threshold achieves the highest signal efficiency of 93.349% at the allocated 8 kHz trigger rate. This represents a 7% absolute improvement over Algorithm-L2 (86.312% at 32 GeV) and a 19% absolute improvement over Algorithm-L3 (74.347% at 30 GeV). The threshold of 34 GeV was determined through systematic scanning across the allowed 20-60 GeV range, finding the optimal balance between signal acceptance and background rejection at the fixed rate allocation. Algorithm-L1's superior performance is attributed to its sophisticated iterative topological clustering approach combined with learned calibration, which better discriminates signal from background compared to the simpler sliding-window (L2) or fixed-window sum (L3) approaches.
